newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel resumes release of Palestinian inmates.
newsitem.headline: Israel resumes release of Palestinian inmates.

text.p: Israel resumed the release of 31 Palestinian women prisoners on Tuesday after the High Court rejected a last-minute petition to keep nine of them behind bars, witnesses said.
Three of the women due for release under Israel-PLO peace deals had already been freed but the others refused to leave prison until authorities allowed all 31 to go free.
Witnesses said a bus left Hasharon prison with 22 women aboard bound for Ramallah in the West Bank where Palestinian President Yasser Arafat was to greet them.
Police detained two right-wing activists protesting against the release outside the prison, witnesses said.
The women, among them two convicted killers, all signed an undertaking to refrain from violence.

The "Families of Arab Terror" group asked the court to halt the release of the nine, saying they were arrested after the Israeli-PLO agreements and were not eligible for freedom. Israel committed itself to release women prisoners in its 1995 peace deal with PLO.
